title: Modicon M241 / M251 / M262
summary: Machine controllers with TM3 expansion modules, programmed in EcoStruxure Machine Expert.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: A logic controller base carries integrated I/O; TM3 digital and analog expansion modules are added on the right.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: Choose the profile `schneider.m200` for a Free Lab project to see digital I/O as IEC direct addresses such as `%IX0.0` and `%QX0.1` and analog channels as `%IW` words, and analog raw values 0..10000 for the nominal range. The PLC is still PLC Lab's single generic IEC 61131-3 runtime; programs are PLC Lab Structured Text, not the vendor's dialect. **SIMULATION APPROXIMATION**: diagnostic texts, timing and module parameters differ from the real product.

modeled: Cyclic scan with input image, transactional program execution and output update
Configured versus installed modules, module status LEDs and diagnostic buffer events
Digital and analog channel behavior including wire break and over/underrange
approximated: Analog values use the PLC Lab 0..10000 convention; the real modules use a configurable range
omitted: Vendor firmware, memory model, task model and instruction set
Online editing, retentive memory and multiple tasks
